title: Yeltsin asks about his trip 'up there'

tellings.quote: "It's been reported to me that you've been up there."

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, the former leader of one of Russia's republics, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that he was taken by aliens in 1997. He says that afterwards Boris Yeltsin, then president of Russia, asked him about it at the Kremlin, Russia's seat of government in Moscow, saying, "It's been reported to me that you've been up there." If true, it would mean the claim reached, and was taken seriously at, the very top of the Russian state.
